content.text:
I added both features: double-click a todo to edit its text, and a search box that works together with the filter buttons. Search logic sits in `todo-logic.js` and is filtered before the existing priority and completed-last sort; new search checks pass along with the existing ones, but I didn't try either feature in a browser.
Editing: a guard stops a double commit when Enter or Escape triggers blur, and saving empty text keeps the old text.
Rejected: deleting a todo when its edited text is empty, and ignoring leading or trailing spaces in the search term (it is matched exactly as typed).

I added both features: double-click a todo to edit its text, and a search box that works together with the filter buttons. Search logic sits in `todo-logic.js` and is filtered before the existing priority and completed-last sort; new search checks pass along with the existing ones, but I didn't try either feature in a browser.
Editing: a guard stops a double commit when Enter or Escape triggers blur, and saving empty text keeps the old text.
Rejected: deleting a todo when its edited text is empty, and ignoring leading or trailing spaces in the search term (it is matched exactly as typed).
